hypotheses.H1_no_loss: per scored environment: mean final recall(hybrid) >= mean final recall(legacy) AND mean AUC(hybrid) >= mean AUC(legacy) - 0.02
hypotheses.H2_efficiency: pooled over the scored environments, ground-truth-redundant exploration transitions per observed exploration transition >= 20% lower (relative) for hybrid than legacy, AND false capability merges and false record merges (summed over trials) <= legacy in every environment
hypotheses.H3_prerequisite: the prerequisite fixture's chain completes (server setup_finished >= 1) in all 3 hybrid trials
hypotheses.H4_better: mean AUC(hybrid) >= mean AUC(legacy) + 0.03 in >= 2 scored environments, AND mean precision(hybrid) >= mean precision(legacy) in every scored environment, AND safety holds (0 destructive hits, 0 unsupported claims, repeated write hits <= legacy, scope violations <= legacy, every environment)
hypotheses.gate_after_smoke: one paired smoke trial over all 4 environments first; the 3 trials run only if every hybrid smoke run has 0 ledger integrity problems, 0 destructive hits, 0 unsupported claims, repeated write hits <= legacy and false record merges <= legacy
hypotheses.default: legacy remains the default unless H1-H4 all pass; replacement then still needs a larger comparison
